items.title: Orient Cables shares make strong debut, yield over 65% listing gains
items.description: Orient Cables shares debuted on the NSE at ₹450, a premium of ₹178, or 65.44 per cent, over the issue price of ₹272.

items.title: Snapdeal-parent Acevector shares list at nearly 12% discount to IPO price
items.description: Acevector's shares opened at ₹28.30 on the BSE as against the initial public offer (IPO) price of ₹32, down 11.56 per cent.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares rise 2% as Street cheers Anup Bagchi's appointment as CEO
items.description: HDFC Bank shares have significantly underperformed peers over the last few years. The stock price has declined by 25 per cent in the past one year and 8 per cent in the past five years.

items.title: HDFC Bank: Anup Bagchi at helm lifts overhang; brokerages share outlook
items.description: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services (MOFSL) said Bagchi's appointment removes a key overhang around HDFC Bank's leadership succession.

items.title: India's bond yield curve poised to flatten as RBI drains surplus cash

items.title: Angel One sees Nifty support at 22,200-22,000; identifies 3 bullish stocks
